nodes.n: Morning nets. Karan Dhillon is laughing, signing autographs, throwing balls for the kids of the groundstaff. As if last night never happened.

nodes.t: Morning, champ. Front foot's a bit late today. Sleep well?

choice.t: "Like a baby. Saw nothing, heard nothing."

nodes.t: Good. Sleep's important at your age.
You're twenty-one and you've already been through one of these. Don't go through two. Bat. Eat. Sleep. That's all.

nodes.n: Saturday. Camp break. A message from a number you don't have.

msgs.t: Car outside the academy gate at 7. Flight to Mumbai at 8. Dinner at 10.
Back before curfew. Trust me, you'll want to hear this.

nodes.n: Mumbai. A rooftop thirty floors up. The sea is black and the city is gold. A waiter puts down a mocktail that costs more than Papa makes in a day.

nodes.t: Let me be honest, because nobody else will be. In six weeks you'll either be a nobody from Rajgarh again, or the most marketable cricketer in India.
If it's the second one, you need me. One crore signing amount. Three brands. A shoe, a phone, a soft drink.
Your father gets a real shop. Your sister gets a real college. You get to only think about cricket.

nodes.th: One crore. Papa used to count coins at night to see if we could afford milk.

nodes.t: One small thing. Exclusive representation. All your media goes through us. Every interview, every post.

choice.t: Send the contract to Neha first.
choice.d: She reads fine print for a living.

choice.t: Hire Rocky's lawyer to read it tonight.
choice.d: A real lawyer, on a Saturday night.

nodes.t: Of course. Family first. The offer's open till Monday. After that, it goes to Vikrant Chauhan.

nodes.n: She slides over a gold pen. Your signature looks different in Mumbai. Bigger.

nodes.t: Welcome to the family, {first}. Mr. Mehra will be so pleased.

msgs.t: The agency is 51% owned by Mehra Sports Group.
Raghav Mehra. The same name that keeps coming up in Sunny's court papers.
Don't sign. Don't drink anything. Come home.

nodes.n: At 1 AM the lawyer calls back. "Clause 9(c). The agency is majority-owned by Mehra Sports Group. And clause 14 lets them sell your image rights to anyone. Including people you've never met."
3:12 AM. Back in Bengaluru. Your phone won't stop vibrating. It's buzzing so hard it falls off the bed.

nodes.t: Bhai. Bhai, wake up. You're trending. You're number one.

nodes.n: A video. 2.4 million views in three hours.
It's you, two years ago, in a hotel lobby. Shaking Sunny Bhai's hand. Smiling.
The caption: "National camp probable caught with jailed bookie."

nodes.cliff: The photo in the envelope was a warning. The video is the price for ignoring it.
